name: Aoba
source:
The current head of the Aoi clan that rules the hidden village of Aoi.
She is Tsumugi's stepmother and also Tsumugi's master.

She is currently said to be the strongest kunoichi
in the Aoi clan. She is a master of the Aoi style ninjutsu secret art of Mosojutsu.

Due to the shortcomings of her own body, she hides an unfathomable desire deep in her heart.
